surfHighlight.title: Surf Lessons for Every Level
surfHighlight.body: Our surf lessons are where Zalty Boyz started — patient, safety-first coaching on the beginner-friendly beach breaks of Puerto Viejo and Cocles. Whether you've never stood on a board or you're chasing your first barrel, we'll match the lesson to you.

toursTeaser.title: Kayak, paddle board, waterfalls & wildlife

hero.title: Surf Lessons in Puerto Viejo & Cocles
hero.subtitle: Small-group and private surf lessons for complete beginners through intermediate surfers, on Puerto Viejo's warm, forgiving beach breaks.

intro.title: Why learn to surf with us
intro.body: Zalty Boyz started as a surf school, and it's still what we do best. Our instructors grew up surfing these exact beaches, so lessons are built around real local conditions — the friendliest breaks for beginners, the safest entry points, and the best tide windows each day.

pickup.title: We come to you
pickup.body: We'll pick you up in our Zalty Tuk Tuk and take you to some of our favorite beaches — including Cocles, Punta Uva, Playa Grande, and more — wherever conditions are best that day, so you get the best lesson possible.

beginner.title: First-Timer
beginner.body: Never stood on a board? We start on the sand with safety, positioning, and pop-up technique before paddling out on a beginner-friendly break.

improver.title: Improver
improver.body: Caught a few waves before? We work on paddle technique, wave selection, and reading the line-up so you can surf more consistently.

advanced.title: Advanced Coaching
advanced.body: Chasing a specific skill — steeper drops, cutbacks, or a trip to a faster wave like Salsa Brava? We tailor the session to your goals.

whatToExpect.title: What to expect
items: Small groups (max 4 students per instructor) or private 1-on-1 lessons
All equipment included: soft-top board, rash guard, and reef-safe sunscreen
Lessons timed to the best tide and swell conditions that day
Photos/video of your session on request

hero.title: About Zalty Boyz
hero.subtitle: A local, family-connected team sharing the Caribbean side of Costa Rica the way we grew up experiencing it.

howItStarted.title: How It Started
paragraphs: It all started as a YouTube channel, Zalty Boyz, back in early 2020, when the world shut down for COVID. We started filming our day-to-day life: surfing, skating, fishing, cliff jumping, traveling, and getting into all kinds of adventures with our friends around the beautiful Caribbean coast of Puerto Viejo. We live the Pura Vida lifestyle, and we wanted to share it.

From there, we turned our passion into our own surf school — most of the boyz have been surf instructors for years, and there's nothing we enjoy more than teaching someone the sport we're lucky enough to do almost every day of our lives. As more visitors asked what else there was to do, we expanded into tours too, showing travelers the beautiful place we call home.
Running the surf school gives us a way to keep doing what we love — and keep making the videos that started it all — while sharing our lifestyle with anyone who wants to come along for the ride.
